description: This line plot illustrates the perplexity of three large language models—LLaMA-7B, LLaMA-13B, and Vicuna-7B—as a function of the number of layers, denoted as 'M', which ranges from 3 to 8 along the linear x-axis. The y-axis represents perplexity, scaled linearly from approximately 20.0 to 40.0. The green line, representing LLaMA-7B, begins at a perplexity of 30.0 when M=3 and increases steadily to approximately 37.0 when M=8. The orange line, representing LLaMA-13B, starts at a perplexity of 21.0 when M=3 and rises to approximately 37.0 when M=8. The blue line, representing Vicuna-7B, begins at a perplexity of 41.0 when M=3, dips slightly to around 39.0 at M=4, then rises steadily to approximately 40.0 at M=8. All three lines show an overall increasing trend in perplexity as M increases from 3 to 8.
